description: This file defines an enum CategorySortingMethod used for specifying sorting options in a notes application, including methods for retrieving sorting IDs and SQL order strings, as well as finding enum instances by ID.

classes.name: CategorySortingMethod
classes.description: An enum representing different sorting methods for categories in the notes app, with associated IDs and SQL order strings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID associated with the sorting method.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the SQL order string for the sorting method.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds and returns the enum instance corresponding to a given ID, with wrap-around logic.
